brief:
Israel's security cabinet has ordered the military to prepare for a potential attack on Iran, according to the Quincy Institute. The directive comes as tensions between the two countries remain heightened following previous exchanges of fire.

No timeline for such an operation was specified in the order. The preparation order reflects Israel's assessment of regional threats and its readiness posture amid ongoing Middle East instability.

media.credit: Benjamin Netanyahu — Wikimedia Commons / US State Department (public domain)

title: Netanyahu's security cabinet orders military to prepare for Iran attack
